question: Where can I get the results of renewable and storage auctions in the United States, with awarded projects, capacity (MW), price, technology and location?

answer.summary: No federal renewable or storage auction or national award list was found; results are published state by state. Best structured source: NYSERDA open data (data.ny.gov dprp-55ye), one row per award with RFP code, technology, county/ZIP, contracted MW, REC strike price and status; NY bulk storage awards are in ugya-enpy (kW, address, no price). Illinois publishes an awards workbook plus ICC notices with average prices; New Jersey BPU orders give per-project prices; California lists utility contracts without price; Massachusetts prices sit in DPU dockets that block automated clients.
main_caveats: Selection, contract filing, approval and cancellation are separate stages: NY open data keeps 147 cancelled awards; MA 83E selected 1,268 MW but filed contracts for 1,118 MW; MA offshore wind rounds II-III were cancelled.
Prices are not comparable across mechanisms: NY Index vs Fixed REC, IL indexed REC/ISC strike (event average, $/MWh), NJ storage $/MW-year, DOE table mixing PPA and OREC levelized prices.
NY open data leaves the price blank for RESRFP24-1 and later awards until commercial operation; 83 of 326 rows carry no price.
Storage awards are published in MW of power; MWh is absent from NY bulk storage, IL and NJ award records and appears only in MA news and bids.
NYSERDA's website, the MA DPU fileroom, FERC and LBNL pages return 403 to automated clients; data.ny.gov, ICC/IPA, NJ BPU and CPUC files were reachable.
answer.confidence_reason: Five state programs tested with real records; other procuring states (CT, RI, ME, MD, VA, utility all-source RFPs) not checked; key NYSERDA and MA DPU pages blocked to automated clients.

attributes.note: Named projects tied to their RFP or event in NY, IL, NJ and MA; CA gives program and RAM round. State by state only; no national list.
MW per project; basis differs (NY contracted portion, IL/NJ AC nameplate, NY storage kW AC). Storage MWh is rarely in official award records.
NY REC strike per project (blank for RESRFP24-1+ until operation); NJ $/MW-year per project; IL only event averages in $/MWh.
attributes.gap_note: MA contract prices are in DPU dockets 26-87/88/89 (fileroom returns 403 to automated clients); CA terms confidential for 3 years; NY bulk storage price absent from open data.

attributes.note: Technology per project in every source checked (e.g., Land-based Wind, Solar, Hydroelectric, Lithium Ion, Utility-Scale Wind).
IL address or coordinates; CA lat/long; NY storage street address; NJ municipality; NY renewables county/ZIP only (point = ZIP centroid).
attributes.gap_note: No official site location found for MA awards on macleanenergy.com or mass.gov pages opened; NY dprp-55ye gives county and ZIP, not the site.

attributes.note: NY renewables through 2026-09-30 (RESRFP25-1); NY storage 2026-11-04; IL file 2026-10-30, IL storage notice 2026-09-01; CA file October 2026.
NY awards since 2004 incl. cancelled; IL awards since 2010 (LTPPA to Summer 2026); CA contracts incl. RAM rounds 1-7. Price mechanisms change between rounds.
Publisher-stated: NY renewables quarterly, NY storage and IL workbook monthly; IL notices per event (REC events twice a year); NJ, MA per solicitation.

inclusion_rule.quote: Projects reported by NYSERDA represent projects which NYSERDA has awarded and approved.

key_fields.meaning: RFP code (e.g., RESRFP25-1, ORECRFP23-1) or older RPS agreement number; ties each award to its round.
Awarded project; the same name can recur across rounds (e.g., Canisteo Wind Energy Center in RESRFP23-1 and RESRFP25-1).
Land-based Wind, Offshore Wind, Solar, Hydroelectric, Biogas, Fuel Cell, etc.
NYSERDA-contracted MW; new_renewable_capacity_mw is the nameplate of new equipment.
Co-located storage power and energy, filled in 15 rows only.
Awarded Index (O)REC strike price or Fixed REC price in US dollars; two different mechanisms.
Whether the strike or fixed price may be adjusted by commodity indices under the RFP.
County and ZIP; georeference is a Socrata geocode of the address components (ZIP centroid in practice).
Cancelled, Canceled - Other, Completed, Operational or Under Development as of the data-through date.
Year NYSERDA payments start (expected for projects under development) and contract years.

steps: Query https://data.ny.gov/resource/dprp-55ye.json with SoQL ($select, $where, $order, $limit); 326 rows on 2026-11-27, so one request with $limit=1000 returns the whole table.
Filter by solicitation_name to get one round; the latest round on 2026-11-27 is RESRFP25-1 (13 rows, 718.91 MW of bid_capacity_mw).
Keep project_status to separate cancelled awards (Cancelled 140, Canceled - Other 7) from Under Development (63), Operational (40) and Completed (76).
Read index_orec_strike_price and fixed_rec_price as separate columns; neither is filled for most offshore wind rows or for RESRFP24-1+ rows that are not yet operational.
Offshore wind awards (ORECRFP18-1 to ORECRFP23-1) are in the same table with renewable_technology = 'Offshore Wind'.
reading_traps: georeference is a Socrata geocode of address components: Flint Mine Solar, Hecate Energy Greene 1 and Greene 2 share the same point (-73.80015, 42.34806), the ZIP 12051 centroid; offshore wind rows carry the onshore county (Kings, Suffolk).
Price fields are blank in 83 of 326 rows; for RESRFP25-1 only the two operational hydro projects show a price (Theresa 92, High Dam 89.7).

A row is an award, not a project: Canisteo appears in RESRFP18-1 (290 MW, Cancelled), RESRFP23-1 (252 MW) and RESRFP25-1 (27 MW); the asterisk convention for repeated names is not applied to all of them.
Status spelling differs ('Cancelled' vs 'Canceled - Other'); group both when counting cancellations.
County can disagree with NYSERDA's announcement: Chateaugay Windpark is Clinton in the data but Franklin County in the 2026-09-23 award notice.
Bulk energy storage awards are not in this table; they are in dataset ugya-enpy.
state_province is blank in 13 rows and points outside New York in 5 (PA 4, QC 1); filter it before mapping.

steps: Illinois (member example): open https://ipa.illinois.gov/energy-procurement/procurement-results.html, pick the event under 'Indexed REC Procurement Results' or 'Energy Storage Procurement Results' and download the ICC 'Public Notice of Successful Bidders and Average Prices' PDF (4 pages).

Extract the tables with pdftotext -layout; each project spans several lines (supplier address, project address or coordinates); rebuild one row per project and copy the single average price to every row of that category.
New Jersey: the GSESP Tranche 1 award table is on p.5 of the BPU order (docket QO22080540); the payment schedule per project is in Appendix A.

Massachusetts: selection and contract-filing notices are posted under the 83C, 83D and 83E menus of https://macleanenergy.com/; the contracts and prices are in the DPU dockets named in the notice (26-87, 26-88, 26-89 for 83E Round I).
New York: NYSERDA award announcements list projects by county only; use the data.ny.gov datasets for MW and price.
reading_traps: Illinois prices are averages: 92.60 $/MWh for all wind/hydro winners and 76.24 $/MWh for all solar winners in June 2026; 110.52 $/MWh for all five storage winners in the 2026-09-01 notice.
Illinois strike prices are indexed: the REC or ISC payment is the strike minus a market index and can be negative, so a strike price is not the payment per MWh.
In the June 2026 Illinois notice Four Creeks LLC (250.00 MW, 731,029 RECs) is printed twice in the wind/hydro table.
New Jersey ranks bids in $/MW UCAP-year but awards and pays in $/MW ICAP-year: Woods Landing is $75,000 per MW ICAP-year and $156,904 per MW UCAP-year.
Massachusetts 'bids' pages list every proposal (13 for 83E Round I), not winners; winners appear in selection and contract-filing notices.

if_unstructured.summary: Outside New York's open data, award results sit in procurement notices, regulator orders and contract dockets; prices and storage MWh often appear only there or not at all.
recipe: List the state's procurement rounds from the index page (IPA results page, BPU agenda calendar, MACleanEnergy.com section menus, DPU docket list).

For each round open the award document (ICC notice, BPU order, MA selection or contract-filing notice) and copy the winners table with pdftotext -layout; rebuild one row per project because names and addresses wrap over several lines.

Record the stage of each document: selection (MA DOER 2024-09-06 offshore wind selection, 2025-12-19 storage selection), contract filing (MA 2026-07-02, DPU 26-87/88/89), regulator approval (ICC vote, BPU order) and later cancellation (MA report Table 2).

Record the price exactly as published with its basis: IL event-average strike $/MWh, NJ $/MW ICAP-year per project, MA round averages such as Vineyard Wind 1 '$89/MWh in nominal dollars'; leave blank where only bids or totals are given.
Keep MW (power) and MWh (energy) apart; official IL, NJ and NY award records give only MW.
if_unstructured.location_method: Use the location printed in the award document: IL notices give a street address or coordinates per project; NJ orders give municipality and county; NY open data gives county/ZIP (renewables) or street address (bulk storage); CA gives latitude/longitude. MA notices opened give no site location.
cross_with: EIA-860 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860/) lists existing and planned generators of 1 MW or more; matching by project name can confirm whether an awarded project was later built.
NYSERDA dprp-55ye interconnection_queue_number and regulatory_permitting fields link NY awards to NYISO queue positions and PSC siting cases.

Trade press reports such as https://www.utilitydive.com/news/massachusetts-utilities-dpu-contracts-energy-storage/824614/ give MWh for MA 83E contracts (Trimount 700 MW/2,800 MWh) that the official notices omit.
